title: Glimpse audit cycle A: first evidence-constrained pass
method: All 60 questions examined against known normative contracts, source drawings, full baseline raster reconnaissance and owner first-slice record. Lack of question-specific source-paired optical/native evidence is UNVERIFIED, not PASS. This is first-pass design evidence assessment, not device or owner acceptance.
currentBranchNote: Five post-atlas source modifications have not yet received independent matching-branch raster confirmation.
